question: Where exactly are Marines okaki made? Where are they sold? I would like to try them! Tomari
answer: I think everyone knows that in the western part of the "South Blue" there is a stubborn okaki artisan, Ayesé Mar. "Okaki are rock'n'roll!!" is his motto. Sengoku loves his okaki, so the Marines buy a supply from him. They sell them at the Marine Headquarters shop. O: Yes. A female reader told me that she has something to say to "Sanada"!
name: Shinonome Tomari
